Bihar MLC Election Results: : patna snatak emaelsi sit (Patna Seat Results) se jediyu ummidvar niraj kumar ( Anant Singh Vs Neeraj Kumar) ne shandar jit darj ki hai. unka mukabla bhale hi rashtriy janta dal dvara ghoshit ummidvar se tha, lekin har mokama se jediyu ke hi bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ne mani hai. is chunav men unhonne apna sabkuchh danv par laga diya.
